notes.title: Demo Patch #3
notes.content:
This patch includes the following:

Added (correct plants / required plants) counter to the Botany minigame to the task message

Fixed task generation in Botany minigame to prevent trivial solutions

Added social links to the Main Menu



If you encounter any issues, feel free to report them through our discord or steam community hub!



/Almost Kind Games Team

notes.title: Patch#1
notes.content:
This patch brings various UI, dialogue, script and sprite adjustments, including (but not limited to):

added setting for cursor scaling (can be used on larger screen resolutions if the cursor becomes too small, e.g. during the park minigame)

fixed bookstore minigame incorrect launch timing

improved tooltip and inventory drag behavior



If you encounter any issues, feel free to report them through our discord or steam community hub!



/Almost Kind Games Team
